testcase.name: Scenario: Select and clears recent rows using the header checkbox: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:170:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select and clears recent rows using the header checkbox ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And several recent documents are displayed in List View ✔ And no recent-document rows are checked ✔ When the user checks the list header checkbox ✔ Then all visible recent-document rows are checked and highlighted ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected appear above the list ✔ When the user clears one visible row's checkbox ✔ Then that row is unchecked while the other visible rows remain checked ✔ And the header checkbox shows a partial selection ✔ When the user activates the partially selected header checkbox ✔ Then all visible recent-document rows are checked again ✔ When the user clears the header checkbox ✔ Then the visible recent-document rows are unchecked ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed above the list
